items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Seeks SEC Approval For A New ETIF Fund Structure
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE: BLK) has asked the SEC to approve a new exchange traded interval fund, or ETIF, structure for alternatives access. The proposed wrapper aims to pair ETF style trading with interval fund redemption features for individual investors seeking alternative assets. BlackRock positions the ETIF concept as a way to broaden public market portfolios beyond traditional stocks and bonds through regulated funds.
